aggregation: Exact polygon-pixel intersection area in EPSG:26912. Include fractional boundary pixels within the county-clipped grid cell; no burnable-land mask.
quantiles: Area-weighted empirical inverse CDF: smallest observed value with cumulative valid-area weight at least the requested probability. Population weighted standard deviation.
aspect: Downhill compass azimuth: north=0, east=90. Northness=cos(aspect), eastness=sin(aspect). Pixels with slope<1 degree contribute zero directional components; average over valid directional-or-flat area. Flat fraction uses valid slope area.
missingness: If a source group covers less than 95% of the clipped cell, leave that group's predictors missing. Keep all known-label rows. Fit imputation separately within each training fold; apply it unchanged to early stopping, validation, calibration and test. Coverage and QA fields are audit metadata, not predictors.
static_terrain_assumption: Use the retained contemporary terrain as a time-invariant geomorphic proxy for 2001-2025 susceptibility. This does not establish historical release availability or account for past excavation, construction or terrain change. It is not a strict operational forecasting hindcast.
area_policy: Include study_area_km2 as an observation-area covariate because county-clipped cells have unequal areas. Preserve small positive-area cells; do not infer source accuracy from their size.
evaluation_policy: Use the reviewed-label cohort identically for both algorithms. Preserve all frozen year roles and geographic blocks/buffers. Do not impute, scale, select features or estimate class weights using all years together.
